text.content:
Rache Bartmoss's last joke, and the death of the Old NET.

When: 2022
Where: The Old NET, worldwide
Who was involved: Rache Bartmoss (dead since 2020) and his RABIDs; NetWatch
What it changed: The Old NET died and was sealed behind the Blackwall; every city built its own sealed net

Two years after Rache Bartmoss died, self-replicating programs called RABIDs tore through the Old NET: banks, hospitals, traffic grids, records of every kind. Nothing on the wire could be trusted, and most of it was gone. A year later the bomb went off in Arasaka Tower, and the world lost its memory and its nerve at the same time.

NetWatch walled off the wreck behind the Blackwall. Every city that rebuilt built a local net of its own, and in Night City netrunning meant going to a building and plugging in; that's why runners still say architecture. Runners date things "pre-Krash" the way everyone else says "before the bomb".

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.06
